edits.before: W online: the gold card re-prices his every step-up. Lock yellow when he walks forward and the lane behaves.
edits.after: W online: Blue Card mana plus Wild Cards out-shove him, and the yellow punishes every soldier last-hit he takes.

edits.before: Full kit: stacked-deck autos plus card cycling is a real short trade — but your game is the clock, not the lane.
edits.after: Full kit: stacked-deck autos and card cycling against his soldier poke — even trades decided by positioning.

edits.before: Lost Chapter timing — Q the wave, lock cards on cooldown, and watch side lanes like they're your KDA.
edits.after: Lost Chapter timing for both — waveclear and range trade evenly; Q the wave and set up for the level 6 flip.

edits.before: Destiny online — THE level in this lane. Every shove is now a bot-lane death sentence with a 130-second timer.
edits.after: Destiny online — THE level: Azir's only escape is Shifting Sands, so Gate behind him or convert shoves into roams.

edits.before: Lich Bane spike: gold card chunks half bars. The lane still isn't the point — the map pays your salary.
edits.after: His Nashor's soldiers now out-range and out-DPS your card burst — chip from max range and let the map pay you.

edits.before: Late TF is a coin with two good sides: split the side lane R-safe, or hold Destiny as the pick-and-collapse button.
edits.after: Skill matchup now: your Destiny picks against his Emperor's Divide teamfights — split R-safe or hold R to collapse.

edits.before: - Azir Shifting Sands: matchup-defining — His shield-dash to a soldier — engage the window after he burns it. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your W gold card like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Azir Shifting Sands: matchup-defining — 22s at rank 1 (16s max), and the shield-dash rides it: engage only after he burns it. - Conquering Sands runs 14s early — poke inside that window. - Destiny (170s) goes to kill windows only.

edits.before: Lock gold off-screen, walk up once, card-auto-Q, and leave — one stun-chunk per cycle is all the lane asks of you.
edits.after: Hold the yellow until he steps up for a trade — the stun mid-step turns his aggression into your best trade window.

edits.before: Cycling cards inside his engage range for stacked-deck greed — TF dies in exactly one mistimed auto-walk per game; don't pre-book it.
edits.after: Azir takes towers faster than you win trades — every Destiny timer spent posturing mid is a bot-lane kill you never collected.

edits.before: Azir wins by landing Shifting Sands, denying your pattern, and renting you the lane at a range markup.
edits.after: Azir wins by stacking soldiers to zone your card walk-ups, then E-Q engaging the moment your yellow is spent.

edits.before: Track Azir’s Shifting Sands: His shield-dash to a soldier — engage the window after he burns it. It’s down or you don’t go.
edits.after: Track Shifting Sands: the dash also shields him and eats your Gold Card burst — force it out first. It’s down or you don’t go.
